newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca climbs ahead of 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca climbs ahead of 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in British bioscience company Zeneca Group Plc rose ahead of the company's 1996 earnings on Tuesday, which are expected to break through the one billion stg profit barrier for the first time.
Broker BZW reiterated its buy recommendation on the stock on Monday, highlighting the company's new product portfolio in both pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals.
Zeneca should produce compound annual earnings growth of 15 percent for the next five years, BZW said in its latest research note.
By 1210 GMT Zeneca shares had risen 12-1/2p to 18.96 stg.
Pre-tax profit forecasts for the group range narrowly between 992 million and 1.01 billion stg, with a majority of analysts clustered just above the 1.0 billion stg level.
